mentions.title: King bearing defect? Please help...mid assembly.
mentions.snippet: Subaru builder stopped mid-assembly over a suspected defect in a King bearing and is asking the forum whether the part is usable. Single builder, product-fault claim, not yet corroborated in the snippet.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread stating King main thrust bearings made since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, and that the thrust main slips onto the cap and block groove with no interference fit, raising a risk of spinning the thrust bearing.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread telling BMW builders to measure every King bearing before installation; the poster reports a set boxed and stamped STD that contained 0.25 shells, attributed to the factory boxing the wrong parts.
